output.summary: KEP-1972 makes kubelet respect exec probe timeouts, treating a timed-out exec probe as a probe failure. A feature gate (ExecProbeTimeout) lets nodes keep the old behavior. The KEP is currently marked implementable, stage stable.
output.rationale: Kubelet ignored the exec probe timeout even though the Container Probe API supports it, which the KEP treats as a bug. Because existing workloads may depend on timeouts never being enforced, a feature gate was added so nodes can preserve the current behavior. The KEP was pushed toward GA quickly, which reviewers later noted was a choice they wanted to avoid for future KEPs.

alternatives.option: Increasing the default timeout for exec probes
alternatives.why_not: Listed as an alternative considered in the KEP; the sources do not say why it was rejected.

alternatives.option: Continuing to ignore the exec probe timeout
alternatives.why_not: Listed as an alternative considered in the KEP; the sources do not say why it was rejected, but the Motivation calls ignoring the timeout a bug to be fixed.

alternatives.option: Expanding scope to also respect timeout in preStop exec hook (RespectExecTimeout flag)
alternatives.why_not: Maintainer andrewsykim said grace termination and probe timeouts are separate concerns and did not want overlap with sidecar efforts; sergeykanzhelev later agreed no flag was needed and the KEP should go ahead as scoped.

alternatives.option: Adding CRI timeout error codes within this KEP
alternatives.why_not: Treated as out of scope; andrewsykim said CRI errors would be addressed in a separate KEP (#1654).

evidence.quote: Kubelet today does not respect exec probe timeouts. This is considered a bug we should fix since the timeout value is supported in the Container Probe API.
Existing workloads may depend on the fact that exec probe timeouts were never respected. Introducing the timeout now may result in unexpected behavior for some workloads.
I agree that we should fix this, but I think grace termination period and probe timeouts are separate concerns here.
So this KEP should be gtg
Yes, we are trying to avoid straight to GA KEPs. Bug fixes with the feature gate have a much less impact.
